name: VR Match Gems – Puzzle Crush Game
summary:
VR Match Gems – Puzzle Crush Game transforms the beloved match-3 puzzle experience into an immersive virtual reality adventure. Step into a vibrant 3D puzzle world where matching colorful gems feels more satisfying than ever before.

Use intuitive VR controls to swap, match, and crush gems while creating powerful chain reactions and special boosters. Each successful match rewards you with smooth visual effects and engaging feedback, making every move feel impactful in VR.
